name: 缸径
def: 气缸的内径。活塞外径略小并留有设计间隙，不能把两者严格等同；与行程共同决定单缸排量。
def_en: The cylinder’s internal diameter. The piston is slightly smaller to provide designed clearance; bore and stroke together determine swept volume.
reason: 纠正缸径严格等于活塞直径。

name: 行程
def: 活塞从上止点到下止点的距离。常规滑块曲柄机构中等于曲拐半径的两倍。
def_en: The distance the piston travels between top and bottom dead centre. In a conventional slider-crank mechanism it is twice the crank radius.

image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 上止点
def: 上止点：活塞在气缸中最接近缸盖的极限位置。四冲程每个循环会两次经过上止点，应区分压缩上止点与排气上止点。
def_en: Top dead centre: the piston position nearest the cylinder head. A four-stroke cycle passes TDC twice, so compression TDC and exhaust TDC must be distinguished.

sources.title: Briggs & Stratton — How a 4-Stroke Engine Works

image.author: Rios
image.caption: 四冲程配气相位示例；IO/IC为进气开闭，EO/EC为排气开闭
image.caption_en: Four-stroke valve-timing example: intake and exhaust opening/closing
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 下止点
def: 下止点：活塞在气缸中离缸盖最远的极限位置，与上止点之间的距离为行程。
def_en: Bottom dead centre: the piston position farthest from the cylinder head. The distance from TDC to BDC is the stroke.

sources.title: Briggs & Stratton — How a 4-Stroke Engine Works

image.author: Rios
image.caption: 四冲程配气相位示例；IO/IC为进气开闭，EO/EC为排气开闭
image.caption_en: Four-stroke valve-timing example: intake and exhaust opening/closing
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 压缩比
def: 压缩前气缸总容积与压缩后余隙容积的比值，即（排量＋余隙容积）／余隙容积。提高压缩比有改善理想循环效率的潜力，但会受爆震、热负荷和实际燃烧限制。
def_en: The ratio of total cylinder volume at BDC to clearance volume at TDC: (swept volume + clearance volume) / clearance volume. Higher ratios can improve ideal-cycle efficiency but face knock, thermal and combustion limits.
reason: 避免压缩比越高实际效率必然越高。

sources.title: US EIA — Gasoline explained: Octane in depth

image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 排量
def: 所有气缸活塞从上止点运动到下止点所扫过容积之和。单缸容积为π／4×缸径²×行程；多缸再乘气缸数。
def_en: The sum of all cylinders’ swept volumes. One cylinder has swept volume π/4 × bore² × stroke; multiply by cylinder count for the engine total.

image.author: 4StrokeEngine_Ortho_3D_Small.gif : Zephyris derivative work: Cdang ( talk )
image.caption: 活塞、连杆与曲轴的运动机构示意
image.caption_en: Piston, connecting rod and crank mechanism
image.file: Piston bielle vilebrequin coupe et schema cinematique.svg
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 曲拐
def: 曲轴主轴线与连杆轴颈中心之间的距离，常称曲拐半径；常规机构的行程为其两倍。曲拐相互方位还决定曲轴的排列形式。
def_en: The offset between the crankshaft main axis and a crankpin centre, commonly called crank radius. Conventional stroke is twice this distance. Relative throw orientations define crankshaft arrangement.

image.author: Freeformer
image.caption: 直列四缸曲轴与活塞机构的几何示意
image.caption_en: Illustrative inline-four crankshaft and piston assembly
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 曲轴
def: 通过连杆把活塞往复运动转为旋转运动的轴，包含主轴颈、连杆轴颈和连接它们的曲柄，并按需要设置配重。
def_en: A shaft that converts piston reciprocation into rotation through connecting rods. It includes main journals, crankpins, webs and, where required, counterweights.

image.author: Freeformer
image.caption: 直列四缸曲轴与活塞机构的几何示意
image.caption_en: Illustrative inline-four crankshaft and piston assembly
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 连杆
def: 连接活塞与曲轴连杆轴颈的构件，在燃烧压力与往复惯性载荷下传力。其长度与几何关系会影响活塞运动和侧向力。
def_en: The member linking a piston to its crankpin, transmitting combustion and inertia loads. Its length and geometry affect piston motion and side force.

sources.title: Briggs & Stratton — How a 4-Stroke Engine Works

image.author: 4StrokeEngine_Ortho_3D_Small.gif : Zephyris derivative work: Cdang ( talk )
image.caption: 活塞、连杆与曲轴的运动机构示意
image.caption_en: Piston, connecting rod and crank mechanism
image.file: Piston bielle vilebrequin coupe et schema cinematique.svg
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 活塞
def: 在气缸内往复运动、承受燃烧气体压力并经连杆输出力的部件。活塞顶形状也参与形成燃烧室和气流。
def_en: A reciprocating component that receives gas pressure and transmits force through the connecting rod. Its crown shape also contributes to the combustion chamber and charge motion.

sources.title: Briggs & Stratton — How a 4-Stroke Engine Works

image.author: User:Wapcaplet
image.caption: 活塞—连杆—曲轴机构示意；图中的 P 表示活塞。
image.caption_en: Piston, connecting-rod and crank mechanism; P marks the piston.
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 活塞环
def: 装在活塞环槽内的弹性环，用于密封燃烧气体、控制缸壁油膜并传递部分热量。压缩环和油环承担的重点功能不同。
def_en: Spring-like rings fitted in piston grooves to seal combustion gases, control cylinder-wall oil and transfer some heat. Compression rings and oil-control rings have different primary roles.

image.author: User:Wapcaplet
image.caption: 四冲程双顶置凸轮轴发动机剖面示意
image.caption_en: Cutaway diagram of a four-stroke DOHC engine
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 缸盖
def: 封闭气缸顶部并构成燃烧室一部分的部件，可容纳气门、火花塞或喷油器等。侧置气门发动机的气门在缸体内，因此不是所有缸盖都含气门机构。
def_en: The component closing the top of the cylinders and forming part of the combustion chambers. It may house valves, plugs or injectors; side-valve engines place their valves in the block instead.

image.author: User:Wapcaplet
image.caption: 四冲程双顶置凸轮轴发动机剖面示意
image.caption_en: Cutaway diagram of a four-stroke DOHC engine
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 点火顺序
def: 多缸发动机各缸开始燃烧做功的先后顺序。它由曲轴、配气与点火／喷油安排共同确定；不能仅从气缸编号或夹角猜测。
def_en: The sequence in which cylinders begin combustion and deliver power. It depends on crankshaft, valve-event and ignition or injection arrangements, not merely cylinder numbering or bank angle.

name: 爆震
def: 火花点火发动机中，正常火焰前方尚未燃烧的末端混合气自燃，引起快速压力振荡的异常燃烧。它不同于火花发生前的早燃，两者可能相互影响。
def_en: Abnormal combustion in a spark-ignition engine where unburned end gas ahead of the flame autoignites, producing rapid pressure oscillations. It differs from preignition before the intended spark, although the phenomena can interact.

sources.title: US EIA — Gasoline explained: Octane in depth

image.author: PerOX
image.caption: 爆震过程的概念动画；不按真实时间比例
image.caption_en: Conceptual animation of engine knock; not in real time
image.visual_review: Viewed Chrome contact sheet outputs/verification/term-image-gallery.png; loading and subject match checked

name: 涡轮迟滞
def: 驾驶者要求更高负荷后，涡轮系统建立相应增压所需的响应延迟。它受转子惯量、排气能量、流道和控制影响，不等同于低于某转速就不能增压的门槛。
def_en: The delay in building the requested boost after an increase in engine demand. It depends on rotor inertia, exhaust energy, flow paths and control, and differs from the boost threshold.

image.author: Kr7cmw0l
image.caption: 涡轮增压汽油机的进排气与中冷器流路示意
image.caption_en: Flow diagram of a turbocharged gasoline engine
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 中冷器
def: 给压气机压缩后的进气降温的换热器，可提高进气密度并降低热负荷及某些工况下的爆震倾向；同时带来体积和压降。
def_en: A heat exchanger that cools compressed intake air, increasing density and reducing thermal load and, in some conditions, knock tendency. It also adds packaging volume and pressure loss.

image.author: Freonr2 at English Wikipedia
image.caption: 增压空气中冷器实物示例
image.caption_en: Example of a charge-air intercooler
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 气门重叠
def: 排气行程结束、进气行程开始附近，进排气门同时开启的曲轴转角区间。它可能帮助换气，也可能导致倒流，作用取决于转速、压力和气道设计。
def_en: The crank-angle interval around the exhaust-to-intake transition when intake and exhaust valves are both open. It may aid scavenging or cause reversion depending on speed, pressures and port design.
reason: 去掉气门重叠必然有利于充气的绝对说法。

image.author: Rios
image.caption: 四冲程配气相位示例；IO/IC为进气开闭，EO/EC为排气开闭
image.caption_en: Four-stroke valve-timing example: intake and exhaust opening/closing
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 凸轮轴
def: 以凸轮轮廓驱动气门或相关机构的轴。轮廓决定升程随转角变化的方式；常规四冲程配气凸轮轴转速为曲轴的一半。
def_en: A shaft whose cam profiles actuate valves or associated mechanisms. The profile determines lift versus angle; a conventional four-stroke valve camshaft turns at half crankshaft speed.

sources.title: Briggs & Stratton — How a 4-Stroke Engine Works

image.author: User:Wapcaplet
image.caption: 四冲程双顶置凸轮轴发动机剖面示意
image.caption_en: Cutaway diagram of a four-stroke DOHC engine
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 平衡轴
def: 带偏心质量、按规定速度和方向旋转以抵消特定惯性力或力矩的轴。不同发动机方案不同；常见直四双平衡轴以两倍曲轴转速反向旋转。
def_en: A shaft with eccentric mass, rotating at a chosen speed and direction to counter specific inertia forces or moments. Designs vary; a common inline-four system uses two counter-rotating shafts at twice crankshaft speed.
reason: 纠正所有平衡轴均倍速反转。

image.author: Sonett72 at English Wikipedia
image.caption: 发动机平衡轴实物示例（框选部位）
image.caption_en: Example of an engine balance shaft, outlined in the image
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 一阶与二阶惯性力
def: 随曲轴转频变化的一阶往复惯性力，与以两倍转频变化的二阶分量区分。气缸布局与曲轴安排决定合力及力矩能否抵消。
def_en: The first-order reciprocating inertia component varying at crankshaft frequency, distinct from the second-order component at twice that frequency. Layout and crank arrangement determine force and moment cancellation.

image.author: Rios
image.caption: 曲柄连杆机构平衡的几何示意
image.caption_en: Geometry of crank-mechanism balancing
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 超方缸径
def: 缸径大于行程的几何关系。短行程可在给定转速下降低平均活塞速度，但实际功率、效率与最高转速还取决于许多其他设计因素。
def_en: A geometry in which bore exceeds stroke. A shorter stroke lowers mean piston speed at a given rpm, but output, efficiency and operating limits depend on many other design choices.
reason: 删除脱离条件的性能因果和未核F1数值。

name: 稀燃
def: 空气相对燃料超过化学计量需求的混合气，λ>1。稀薄燃烧可在适当条件下降低部分损失，但燃烧稳定性和NOx处理需要配套。
def_en: A mixture containing more air relative to fuel than stoichiometry requires, with lambda above 1. Lean operation can reduce some losses under suitable conditions but introduces stability and NOx-control challenges.

sources.title: Mazda — Explanation on Next Generation Engine

name: 压燃
def: 靠压缩空气升温使燃料自燃的着火方式，通常指压缩着火。传统柴油在高温空气中喷油；HCCI则预先形成较均匀混合气，二者混合过程不同。
def_en: Compression ignition: fuel autoignites because compression has raised charge temperature. Conventional diesels inject into hot air, whereas HCCI starts with a largely premixed charge; their mixture formation differs.
reason: ID沿用ignition，但en应为Compression ignition，不能泛称所有点火。

sources.title: Mazda — Explanation on Next Generation Engine

name: 缸内直喷
def: 燃料直接喷入气缸主燃烧室的喷射方式，与进气道喷射及柴油预燃室间接喷射区分。GDI专指汽油直喷，柴油也可采用直喷。
def_en: Direct injection introduces fuel into the main cylinder chamber rather than an intake port or a diesel prechamber. GDI specifically means gasoline direct injection; diesels can also use direct injection.
reason: 保留现有ID，区分通用DI与专用GDI。

image.author: Ton1~commonswiki
image.caption: BMW汽油缸内直喷发动机的剖面模型
image.caption_en: Sectioned BMW gasoline direct-injection engine model
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 共轨
def: 高压泵向公共油轨供油，油轨作为压力储存与分配容积，各缸喷油器独立受控。压力生成与喷射事件分开，轨压仍随控制目标和工况调整。
def_en: A high-pressure pump feeds a shared rail that stores and distributes pressurized fuel to individually controlled injectors. Pressure generation is separated from injection events, while target pressure still varies with conditions.
reason: 纠正压力与转速无关的过度简化。

sources.title: Bosch Mobility — Common-rail system with solenoid injectors

image.author: Smakkeloep
image.caption: 共轨燃油供给系统示意
image.caption_en: Common-rail fuel-system schematic
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 可变气门正时
def: 改变气门开闭时刻相对曲轴位置的系统。常见相位器整体平移凸轮轴相位；改变升程或持续角属于相关但不同的可变配气功能。
def_en: A system that varies valve-event timing relative to crankshaft position. A common cam phaser shifts cam phase; variable lift or duration are related but distinct valvetrain functions.
reason: 区分相位、升程和持续角。

image.author: Rios
image.caption: 四冲程配气相位示例；IO/IC为进气开闭，EO/EC为排气开闭
image.caption_en: Four-stroke valve-timing example: intake and exhaust opening/closing
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 可变压缩比
def: 让发动机在运行中改变几何压缩比的技术概念，可通过不同机械结构实现。它不等于只靠气门关闭时刻改变有效压缩过程。
def_en: A technology that changes geometric compression ratio during operation through a mechanical arrangement. It differs from changing the effective compression process solely by altering valve-closing timing.

name: 增压
def: 压气机提高进气压力的过程或结果。表示数值时必须区分相对于环境压力的表压和绝对压力；同一增压值不代表所有发动机有相同进气量。
def_en: The process or result of increasing intake pressure with a compressor. Numerical values must distinguish gauge from absolute pressure; equal boost does not imply equal airflow across engines.

image.author: Kr7cmw0l
image.caption: 涡轮增压汽油机的进排气与中冷器流路示意
image.caption_en: Flow diagram of a turbocharged gasoline engine
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 热效率
def: 制动热效率是发动机输出轴机械功率与燃料输入化学能速率之比，需说明燃料热值口径和测量工况。它不同于整车油耗，也不同于指示热效率。
def_en: Brake thermal efficiency is shaft mechanical power divided by the rate of chemical energy supplied in fuel. Heating-value convention and operating point must be stated. It differs from vehicle fuel economy and indicated efficiency.
reason: 删除脱离测试工况的最新效率纪录断言。

image.author: Luc1992
image.caption: 理想奥托循环的压力—容积图；不等同真实发动机每个工况
image.caption_en: Pressure-volume diagram of an ideal Otto cycle, not a real operating map
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheet 2; image loading and subject checked

name: 配气相位
def: 进排气门相对于曲轴转角的开启与关闭时刻，常用相对上、下止点的角度表示。持续角和重叠角由这些事件决定；正时驱动是实现同步的硬件。
def_en: The opening and closing events of intake and exhaust valves expressed in crankshaft angle, often relative to TDC or BDC. These events determine duration and overlap; the timing drive is the hardware maintaining synchronization.

image.author: Rios
image.caption: 四冲程配气相位示例；IO/IC为进气开闭，EO/EC为排气开闭
image.caption_en: Four-stroke valve-timing example: intake and exhaust opening/closing
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 顶置气门
def_en: In automotive usage, usually a cam-in-block layout operating head-mounted valves through pushrods and rockers. The distinction from OHC is chiefly camshaft location.
def: 汽车语境通常指凸轮轴在缸体内、用推杆与摇臂驱动缸盖气门的布局。它与OHC的差别主要是凸轮轴位置，并非气门是否在顶部。

sources.title: GM — The Small Block comes home
Briggs & Stratton — How a 4-Stroke Engine Works

image.author: IJB TA at English Wikipedia ( Original text: Ian Brockhoff )
image.caption: 推杆式顶置气门机构示意
image.caption_en: Pushrod overhead-valve mechanism
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 顶置凸轮轴
def_en: A valvetrain architecture with the camshaft in the cylinder head. SOHC normally has one cam per head and DOHC two; cam count and valve count are separate parameters.
def: 凸轮轴布置在缸盖内的配气架构。SOHC通常每个缸盖一根凸轮轴，DOHC通常每个缸盖两根；凸轮轴数量和气门数量是不同参数。

sources.title: Honda Engines — OHC

image.caption_en: Sectioned model of a DOHC cylinder head
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 双顶置凸轮轴
def_en: Typically two camshafts per cylinder head, controlling intake and exhaust valves separately. A DOHC V-engine normally has four cams in total. DOHC does not automatically mean four valves per cylinder.
def: 每个缸盖通常有两根凸轮轴，分别控制进气和排气气门。V型发动机若每侧都有DOHC，整机通常共四根凸轮轴；DOHC不自动等于每缸四气门。

sources.title: Peugeot — L500 R HYbrid and the L76 heritage

image.caption: 双顶置凸轮轴缸盖剖面模型
image.caption_en: Sectioned model of a DOHC cylinder head
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 废气再循环
def_en: Recirculates part of the exhaust into the intake to change the cylinder charge and reduce NOx formation. It is an in-engine control measure, with flow and cooling varied by operating condition.
def: 把部分排气重新引入进气，改变气缸内混合物并降低NOx形成。它是发动机内部的排放控制手段；再循环率和冷却需求随工况变化。

sources.title: Cummins — Decarbonizing combustion: Tier 4, Stage V and beyond

image.author: Towel401
image.caption: Škoda BNM发动机EGR部件实物
image.caption_en: EGR component from a Škoda BNM engine
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 三元催化器
def_en: An exhaust catalyst that oxidizes CO and hydrocarbons and reduces NOx near stoichiometric operation and at suitable temperature. “Three-way” refers to these pollutant conversions, not three filter layers.
def: 在合适温度和近化学计量混合气下，促进CO、碳氢化合物氧化以及NOx还原的排气净化装置。“三元”指三类污染物，不是三层滤网。

sources.title: Volvo Cars — 30 years of Lambda Sond

name: 柴油颗粒过滤器
def_en: Traps exhaust particles and regenerates by oxidizing accumulated soot. Non-combustible ash still requires maintenance. A DPF is not itself a complete NOx-treatment system.
def: 在排气中捕集颗粒物，通过再生氧化积累的碳烟。不能燃烧掉的灰分仍需按系统要求维护；DPF本身不等于NOx处理系统。

name: 选择性催化还原
def_en: Commonly uses ammonia derived from aqueous urea to convert NOx into nitrogen and water over a catalyst. AdBlue/DEF is supplied to the exhaust system, not mixed into the diesel fuel tank.
def: 常利用尿素水溶液在排气中产生氨，在催化器上将NOx转为氮气和水。AdBlue/DEF是还原剂供应液，不是掺入柴油油箱的燃料添加剂。

name: 发动机控制单元
def_en: An electronic controller that uses sensor inputs, software and calibration to command fueling, ignition and other engine actuators. Its scope varies by generation and engine system.
def: 读取传感器信号，按程序和标定控制喷油、点火及其他发动机执行器的电子装置。具体功能随年代、发动机和控制系统而变。

name: 空燃比
def_en: The mass of air divided by the mass of fuel. The stoichiometric ratio depends on fuel composition, so a petrol reference value must not be applied indiscriminately to ethanol or all blends.
def: 空气质量与燃料质量之比。完全燃烧所需的化学计量空燃比取决于燃料组成，因此不能把某个汽油数值套用于乙醇或所有混合燃料。

name: 过量空气系数
def_en: Actual AFR divided by the stoichiometric AFR of that fuel. Lambda equals 1 at stoichiometry, exceeds 1 for lean mixtures and is below 1 for rich mixtures. It is dimensionless.
def: 实际空燃比除以该燃料的化学计量空燃比。λ=1为化学计量，λ>1偏稀，λ<1偏浓；它是无量纲比值。

name: 点火线圈
def_en: Converts low-voltage electrical energy into a high-voltage pulse able to fire a spark plug. It may feed a distributor or serve an individual cylinder; mounting arrangements vary.
def: 把低压电能转换为足以击穿火花塞间隙的高压脉冲的装置。可集中供给分电器，也可每缸独立；独立线圈与火花塞集成位置因设计而异。

sources.title: Chevrolet — Small-Block Engine Timeline

name: 火花塞
def_en: A component that turns a high-voltage pulse into a spark across its electrodes to ignite the charge. It is different from a diesel glow plug, and spark timing is not fixed at top dead centre.
def: 把高压电脉冲在电极间形成火花、点燃混合气的部件。火花塞不是柴油预热塞；点火时刻也不固定等于活塞到达上止点的时刻。

sources.title: Briggs & Stratton — How a 4-Stroke Engine Works

name: 磁电机点火
def_en: A mechanically driven ignition generator that produces its own electrical energy, so ignition need not depend on a battery. A high-voltage magneto supplies pulses to spark plugs.
def: 通过机械驱动磁场变化产生电能并形成点火脉冲的系统，可不依赖蓄电池供给点火能量。高压磁电机可直接为火花塞提供高压。

name: 分电器
def_en: A traditional device that routes ignition voltage to each cylinder in sequence. Some designs also contain breaker points or timing-advance mechanisms. Individual electronic coils can eliminate high-voltage distribution.
def: 传统多缸点火系统中，把点火高压按顺序送往各缸火花塞的装置；部分设计还承担触点控制或机械提前角调节。电子独立线圈系统可省去高压分配功能。

name: 化油器
def_en: Uses intake pressure differences to introduce fuel into the airflow. Metering depends on jets, fuel level, throttle position and compensating circuits such as those for cold starting.
def: 主要利用进气压差使燃油进入空气流、形成混合气的装置。计量精度还取决于喷嘴、油面、节气门及冷启动等补偿回路。

name: 干式油底壳
def_en: Scavenge pumps move oil from the crankcase to a separate reservoir, while a pressure pump supplies the engine. This supports oil control under acceleration; “dry” does not mean oil-free.
def: 用回油泵把曲轴箱内机油送到独立储油容积，再由压力泵供给发动机。可减小油液晃动对供油的影响；“干式”不表示没有机油。

name: 平面曲轴
def_en: In a typical V8, the crank throws lie in one plane at 0° and 180° orientations. This is distinct from bank angle and affects inertia forces, firing arrangement and exhaust pulses.
def: 用于典型V8时，曲拐位于同一平面并采用0°／180°方位。它与两排气缸夹角是不同参数，会影响惯性力、点火排列和排气脉冲。

name: 交叉曲轴
def_en: In a typical V8, crank throws occupy orientations separated by 90°, forming a cross in end view. Counterweight and firing arrangements differ from a flat-plane V8. The term also appears in other engine layouts, so context matters.
def: 用于典型V8时，曲拐分布在相差90°的方位，从端面看呈十字。配重和点火顺序与平面曲轴不同；“交叉曲轴”也被用于其他气缸布局，须说明语境。

name: 预燃室
def_en: A small combustion volume connected to the main chamber by passages. Petrol jet ignition and diesel indirect injection use different combustion strategies.
def: 与主燃烧室通过孔道相连的小燃烧空间。汽油预燃室点火和柴油间接喷射使用不同燃烧组织，必须结合上下文区分。

name: 泵喷嘴
def_en: Integrates a high-pressure pump and injector nozzle for each cylinder. Unlike common rail, it does not rely on a shared high-pressure accumulator. A unit pump instead connects to a separate nozzle by a high-pressure line.
def: 每缸把高压泵和喷油嘴集成为一个组件的供油方案。与把高压燃油存入公共轨道的共轨不同；单体泵则仍通过高压管连接独立喷嘴。

name: 灵活燃料
def_en: The ability of an engine and fuel system to operate across an approved range of petrol–ethanol blends. Compatible materials, fueling capacity, cold-start provisions and calibration are required; approved ranges vary by market.
def: 发动机和燃油系统可在批准范围内适应不同比例汽油与乙醇的能力。兼容材料、喷油能力、冷启动和标定都需配套；不同国家批准的燃料范围可能不同。

name: 正时驱动
def_en: A belt, chain or gear system that maintains the phase relationship between crank and cam. A conventional four-stroke cam rotates at half crankshaft speed. The drive hardware is distinct from valve-event timing.
def: 通过皮带、链条或齿轮维持曲轴和凸轮轴相位关系的机构。常规四冲程中凸轮轴转速为曲轴的一半；它不同于决定气门何时开闭的配气相位参数。

name: 辛烷值
def_en: A measure of knock resistance under standardized test conditions. RON and MON use different tests, while AKI is their average. The rating is neither calorific value nor the fuel’s percentage of octane molecules.
def: 表征燃料在规定试验条件下抗爆震能力的指标。RON与MON采用不同试验条件，AKI为两者平均；辛烷值不是燃料热值，也不是汽油中辛烷的体积分数。

sources.title: US EIA — Gasoline explained: Octane in depth

name: 均质充量压燃
def_en: A combustion concept in which a largely premixed fuel–air charge autoignites after compression heating. Ignition timing and load range are difficult to control. SPCCI uses a spark to control compression ignition and should not be treated as an exact synonym.
def: 预先较均匀混合的燃料与空气在压缩升温后自燃的燃烧概念。控制着火时刻和可用负荷范围很困难；SPCCI通过火花参与控制，是相关的具体实现，不能当作完全同义词。

sources.title: Mazda — Explanation on Next Generation Engine

name: 氧传感器
def_en: Measures exhaust oxygen condition for closed-loop mixture control or catalyst monitoring. Narrowband and wideband sensors behave differently; output voltage is not a universal air–fuel-ratio scale.
def: 测量排气含氧状态，为混合气闭环控制或催化器监测提供信号的传感器。窄域与宽域类型输出特性不同，不能简单把电压大小当作所有传感器通用的空燃比刻度。

sources.title: Volvo Cars — 30 years of Lambda Sond

image.caption_en: An exhaust oxygen sensor

name: 共轨压力
def_en: Fuel pressure in the shared high-pressure rail. The controller commands a target for operating conditions. Separating pressure generation from injection increases control freedom; it does not make rail pressure constant at every speed and load.
def: 公共高压油轨内的燃油压力。控制系统按工况设定目标压力；“压力生成与喷射分离”表示控制自由度提高，不表示压力在所有转速和负荷下固定不变。

name: 停缸
def: 让部分气缸暂时停止燃烧，常同时停油并关闭气门，以改善特定低负荷工况的效率。
def_en: Temporarily stops combustion in selected cylinders, commonly with fuel cut and closed valves, to improve selected light-load conditions.

sources.title: US EPA — Regulatory Impact Analysis, MY2012–2016 light-duty standards

name: 无凸轮轴
def: 用独立执行器控制气门，代替凸轮直接规定运动；仍需气门及能量供应、控制和耐久设计。
def_en: Independent actuators replace cam-defined valve motion, while valves, power supply and control remain necessary.

sources.title: Freevalve — Cam-less valve train opportunities

name: 分层混合气
def: 气缸内不同区域的空气燃料比例不同，通常在点火附近形成更易点燃的区域；不是所有缸内直喷都采用分层稀燃。
def_en: Different regions contain different air–fuel ratios, often with an ignitable region near the spark. Direct injection does not always mean stratified lean operation.

sources.title: Honda 75 Years — CVCC engine

image.author: 韋駄天狗
image.caption: Honda Collection Hall的CVCC发动机展品
image.caption_en: CVCC engine displayed at the Honda Collection Hall
image.visual_review: viewed in model-image-gallery.png; loaded and subject/caption matched on 2026-10-15

name: 半球形燃烧室
def: 燃烧室总体呈半球状的设计路线；实际形状受气门、火花塞和活塞顶影响，HEMI品牌名不能替代具体几何。
def_en: A broadly hemispherical chamber form; valves, plugs and piston crowns modify its geometry. The HEMI name alone is not a complete specification.

sources.title: Stellantis — HEMI Day: Running the numbers on history-making engines

name: 屋脊燃烧室
def: 缸盖燃烧室顶部呈两侧斜面、近似屋脊，便于布置两组气门；不自动等于DOHC或某个固定气门数。
def_en: Two sloping roof surfaces accommodate valve groups; the shape does not itself specify DOHC or a fixed valve count.

sources.title: Honda — B16A Integra VTEC

name: 楔形燃烧室
def: 燃烧室间隙总体形成楔形，常与挤流区域配合组织气流；名称描述空间形状，不能单独推断效率。
def_en: A tapered chamber shape often used with squish regions; geometry alone cannot establish efficiency.

sources.title: General Motors — Combustion chamber, US2791996A

name: 风冷
def: 发动机通过散热片与气流直接交换热量，可辅以机油散热；与液冷的水套、冷却液和散热器回路不同。
def_en: Fins transfer engine heat directly to airflow, sometimes assisted by oil cooling.

sources.title: Volkswagen — The Beetle: a success story
Citroën — 75 years of the 2CV

name: 液冷
def: 冷却液流经发动机水套，再向散热器和空气放热；水泵、节温器及控制策略共同管理温度。
def_en: Coolant carries heat from engine jackets to a radiator and surrounding air.

sources.title: Porsche — Why the 911 switched to a water-cooled engine

image.author: User:Wapcaplet
image.caption: 四冲程剖面图；图中W为冷却水套
image.caption_en: Four-stroke cutaway; W marks the water jacket
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 脂肪酸甲酯
def: 常见生物柴油的酯类组成；与经加氢制成的烃类HVO不同，混用比例须遵守适用的车辆与燃料规范。
def_en: An ester commonly used as biodiesel, chemically different from hydrotreated hydrocarbon fuel.

sources.title: US DOE AFDC — Biodiesel blends
US DOE AFDC — Renewable diesel

name: 加氢植物油燃料
def: 常用来指通过加氢处理油脂制成的烃类可再生柴油；原料也可含废油脂或动物脂肪，不是FAME的别名。
def_en: Hydrotreated hydrocarbon renewable diesel; feedstocks can include waste oils or fats. It is not another name for FAME.

sources.title: US DOE AFDC — Renewable diesel

name: MultiAir
def: 在凸轮轴与进气门之间用油腔和电磁阀调节气门动作；它保留凸轮驱动能量来源，不等于完全无凸轮轴。
def_en: An oil chamber and solenoid control the link between cam motion and intake valves. It retains a cam-driven energy source.

sources.title: Fiat — MultiAir technical video description

name: 48V轻混
def: 通常以较小的电机和电池支持启停、回收与助力。48V是电压等级，不保证具有持续纯电行驶能力。
def_en: A typically compact motor/battery system supports restart, recuperation and assistance. Voltage alone does not guarantee sustained electric driving.

sources.title: Mercedes-Benz — Technology strategy, 2019

name: 皮带式起动发电机
def: 通过皮带与发动机相连，兼任起动、发电及部分助力。RSG常为同类德文简称，不能与每种ISG结构混同。
def_en: A belt-coupled machine providing starting, generation and limited assistance; RSG is a common German abbreviation.

sources.title: Mercedes-Benz — Technology strategy, 2019

name: 集成式起动发电机
def: 集成于动力传动中的电机兼做起动与发电，并可回收或助力；具体安装位置和可纯电范围依系统而异。
def_en: An integrated drivetrain machine combining starting and generation with recuperation or assistance; placement and electric-driving capability vary.

sources.title: Mercedes-Benz — Technology strategy, 2019

name: 可变几何涡轮
def: 常用可动导叶改变涡轮入口流动条件，使增压器适应不同排气流量；VNT和VTG是相关命名。
def_en: Movable turbine inlet vanes adapt flow conditions to changing exhaust demand.

sources.title: Garrett — Types of turbo

image.author: Alexandre Prévot from Nancy, France
image.caption: Porsche 997 Turbo车型外观；采用VTG的应用实例
image.caption_en: Porsche 997 Turbo exterior; a VTG application
image.visual_review: viewed in model-image-gallery.png; loaded and subject/caption matched on 2026-10-15

name: 双涡管
def: 同一涡轮壳内分隔两路排气，减少不同气缸脉冲的相互干扰；它仍可只有一个涡轮增压器。
def_en: Separated exhaust passages in one turbine housing preserve pulse behaviour; this can still be one turbocharger.

sources.title: BorgWarner — Dual-volute turbocharger

name: 双涡轮
def: 使用两个涡轮增压器的系统总称；可并联、按工况顺序投入或组成两级串联系统，不能仅凭数量判断气路。
def_en: Two turbochargers may operate in parallel, enter sequentially, or form serial stages; count alone does not describe routing.

sources.title: Garrett — Types of turbo
Porsche — Story of the 959

name: 顺序双涡轮
def: 按工况逐步投入两个增压器；强调启用策略，不自动表示空气必须连续经过两个压气机。
def_en: Brings two turbochargers into operation according to conditions; sequencing does not itself define serial compressor flow.

sources.title: Porsche — Story of the 959

name: 两级串联增压
def: 空气依次通过低压级和高压级压气机；旁通机构可改变不同工况的工作路径，不等同于并联双涡轮。
def_en: Air passes through low- and high-pressure compressor stages, with bypass control changing the operating path.

sources.title: Garrett — Types of turbo

name: 废气旁通阀
def: 让部分排气绕过涡轮，调节增压器获得的能量并限制增压；不同于进气侧泄压阀。
def_en: Diverts some exhaust around the turbine to control its power and boost; distinct from an intake-side relief valve.

sources.title: Garrett — Types of turbo

image.author: Kr7cmw0l
image.caption: 汽油增压系统图中的涡轮废气旁通阀
image.caption_en: Turbine wastegate in a turbocharged gasoline-engine system
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 罗茨式增压器
def: 以同步旋转的叶形转子搬运气体的容积式增压器路线；汽车机械增压版本由发动机提供驱动功。
def_en: A positive-displacement blower using synchronized lobed rotors; mechanically driven automotive versions consume engine shaft power.

sources.title: Eaton — TVS automotive superchargers

name: 防迟滞系统
def: 在收油等过渡中维持涡轮转速的控制策略，可协调空气、供油与点火；不同方案不能都概括为排气放炮。
def_en: Maintains turbo speed during transients through coordinated air, fuel and ignition control; implementations differ.

sources.title: Link Engine Management — Motorsport features
Link ECU — G4X FuryX specifications

name: 水喷射
def: 将水雾喷入进气等位置，利用蒸发吸热降低温度与爆震倾向；水在这里是冷却介质，不是提供能量的燃料。
def_en: Water evaporation cools the charge and can reduce knock tendency; water is the cooling medium, not an energy source.

sources.title: BMW — New 2016 M4 GTS

name: 发动机小型化
def: 通过减小排量并配合增压、供油和控制维持目标性能；真实油耗仍取决于负荷与整车使用条件。
def_en: Reduces displacement while using boosting and control to retain target performance; real consumption remains load-dependent.

sources.title: Audi Service Training — Chain-driven TFSI engine / EA888 (document mirror)
Ford India — 2012 engine award archive

name: 主／副连杆
def: 星形机常用一根主连杆连接曲柄销，其他副连杆铰接在主连杆大端周围；各缸几何不完全相同。
def_en: A radial engine commonly has one master rod on the crankpin, with the other rods articulated around its big end.

sources.title: FAA — Airframe and Powerplant Mechanics Powerplant Handbook AC65-12A

name: 曲柄销
def: 偏离曲轴主轴线、承接连杆大端的轴颈；偏心距离是曲柄半径，不能与整个曲轴或主轴颈混为一谈。
def_en: The offset journal supporting a connecting-rod big end; its offset is the crank radius.

sources.title: FAA — Airframe and Powerplant Mechanics Powerplant Handbook AC65-12A

image.author: Freeformer
image.caption: 曲轴模型中的偏心轴颈用于连接连杆
image.caption_en: Offset crank journals connect to the rods in this crankshaft model
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 摇摆力矩
def: 沿发动机不同位置的惯性作用形成的转动力矩；即使合力接近零，发动机仍可能有摇摆趋势。
def_en: Separated inertia forces can create a rotating moment even when their net force cancels.

sources.title: US Patent 4,565,169 — Balancing apparatus for three-cylinder engines

name: 二阶惯性力
def: 每个曲轴转动周期出现两次变化的往复惯性分量，来自连杆有限长度造成的非正弦运动；不是第二次点火。
def_en: A reciprocating-inertia component varying twice per crank revolution because finite rod length makes piston motion non-sinusoidal.

sources.title: Mitsubishi Motors — Company history
Nissan — Reciprocating internal combustion engine, US6390035B2

image.author: Sonett72 at English Wikipedia
image.caption: 用于减振的平衡轴零件参考
image.caption_en: A balance-shaft component used for vibration reduction
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 曲轴扭振
def: 燃烧与惯性作用使曲轴沿自身轴线发生周期性扭转振动；与整台发动机上下振动或摇摆不是同一现象。
def_en: Periodic twisting about the crankshaft axis, distinct from whole-engine shaking or rocking.

sources.title: FAA — Airframe and Powerplant Mechanics Powerplant Handbook AC65-12A
Schaeffler — Pioneering spirit

name: 双质量飞轮
def: 把飞轮分成相对可转的两部分，通过弹性和阻尼环节减少扭振向传动系传递；不等于发动机平衡轴。
def_en: Two flywheel masses coupled through compliant damping reduce torsional vibration transmitted to the driveline.

sources.title: Schaeffler — Pioneering spirit

name: 有效压缩比
def: 按实际参与压缩的气体容积计算的比值；受进气门关闭等过程影响，与只按上下止点容积算的几何压缩比有别。
def_en: A ratio based on the effective volume undergoing compression; valve closure can change it without changing geometric compression ratio.

sources.title: ISO 2710-1:2026 — Engine design and operation vocabulary
Toyota — Birth of the Prius, engine development

image.author: Rios
image.caption: 四冲程气门正时图；进气门关闭时刻影响有效压缩过程
image.caption_en: Four-stroke valve timing; intake closing affects the effective compression process
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 扫气
def: 排出缸内残余废气并引入新鲜充量的过程。二冲程尤其依赖气口与气流组织；扫气可送入空气或混合气。
def_en: Replacing residual cylinder gases with fresh charge, especially important to two-stroke port and airflow design.

sources.title: ISO 2710-1:2026 — Engine design and operation vocabulary
Bosch — History of gasoline injection

name: 泵气损失
def: 发动机进气和排气交换所消耗的功；节流与排气背压会影响它，不能把全部发动机损失都归为泵气损失。
def_en: Work consumed by gas exchange, affected by throttling and exhaust back-pressure; only one part of total engine loss.

sources.title: US EPA — Regulatory Impact Analysis, MY2012–2016 light-duty standards
Fiat — MultiAir technical video description

name: 凸轮型线
def: 凸轮表面形状规定随转角变化的驱动运动，影响气门升程、速度、加速度与持续时间；与整体相位调整不同。
def_en: Cam surface geometry defines motion versus angle, affecting lift and duration; it differs from shifting the complete cam phase.

sources.title: Honda — B16A Integra VTEC

image.author: IJB TA at English Wikipedia ( Original text: Ian Brockhoff )
image.caption: 推杆配气机构中的凸轮、推杆与气门
image.caption_en: Cam, pushrod and valves in an OHV mechanism
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 氮氧化物
def: 发动机排放语境中主要讨论NO与NO₂等氮氧化物；EGR与SCR分别从形成和后处理阶段控制它们。
def_en: Engine-emission nitrogen oxides, principally NO and NO₂; EGR affects formation while SCR treats exhaust.

sources.title: Cummins — How an aftertreatment system works

image.author: Hastdutoene
image.caption: 柴油SCR后处理系统示意；用于降低氮氧化物
image.caption_en: Diesel SCR aftertreatment schematic for NOx reduction
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 电子节气门
def: 以电动执行器和控制器调节节气门开度、控制进气；踏板请求不必与阀门角度一一机械对应。
def_en: An actuator and controller regulate throttle opening; pedal demand need not mechanically map one-to-one to valve angle.

sources.title: Bosch Motorsport — Electronic throttle body

image.author: Kr7cmw0l
image.caption: 汽油增压系统图中的节气门位置
image.caption_en: Throttle location in a turbocharged gasoline-engine system
image.visual_review: Viewed in Chrome contact sheets; subject and image loading checked

name: 可变进气歧管
def: 改变进气通道长度或连接方式，利用不同转速下的气流惯性与压力波改善充气；不同于改变气门正时。
def_en: Changes runner length or connectivity to exploit airflow inertia and pressure waves at different speeds.

sources.title: MANN+HUMMEL — Variable intake manifolds

name: MGU-H
def: 连接涡轮增压器轴的电机发电机，通过轴的机械功回收能量或帮助增压器加速；并非直接把热变成电。
def_en: A motor-generator on the turbo shaft, recovering shaft energy or accelerating the turbo; not direct heat-to-electric conversion.

sources.title: Honda — Evolution of hybrid technologies MGU-H/MGU-K

name: MGU-K
def: 与动力传动相连的电机发电机，制动等工况回收机械能，驱动时提供助力。额度与功率受对应赛季规则约束。
def_en: A drivetrain motor-generator that recuperates mechanical energy and provides assistance, within season-specific limits.

sources.title: Honda — Evolution of hybrid technologies MGU-H/MGU-K

name: ERS-K
def: F1规则中的动能回收系统口径，涵盖相关电能与控制约束；2026的350kW是指定测量边界的直流功率上限。
def_en: The regulated kinetic-energy-recovery system; the 2026 350 kW figure is a DC-power ceiling at the specified boundary.

sources.title: FIA — 2026 F1 Regulations Section C Technical, Issue 20, 5 August 2026

name: 直流电功率
def: 在直流电路测量边界上按电压与电流得到的能量传递速率；电机轴端机械功率因转换损失不必相同。
def_en: Electrical energy-transfer rate at a DC measurement boundary; shaft power differs because conversion is not lossless.

sources.title: FIA — 2026 F1 Regulations Section C Technical, Issue 20, 5 August 2026

name: 燃料能量流量
def: 单位时间送入发动机的燃料化学能，可由质量流量乘低热值求得；质量流量相同不保证能量流量相同。
def_en: Fuel chemical energy supplied per unit time: mass flow multiplied by lower heating value.

sources.title: FIA — 2026 F1 Regulations Section C Technical, Issue 20, 5 August 2026
ISO 2710-1:2026 — Engine design and operation vocabulary

name: 变性剂
def: 加入酒精使其不适合饮用的物质；在燃料规则中是特定添加组分类别，不等于所有添加剂或燃料主体。
def_en: A substance added to alcohol to make it unsuitable for beverage use; distinct from the bulk fuel and from additives generally.

sources.title: US TTB — What makes a good denaturant?
FIA — 2026 F1 Regulations Section C Technical, Issue 20, 5 August 2026

name: 制动比油耗
def: 每输出单位轴端功所消耗的燃料质量，常用g/kWh；必须注明工况，不能当作整车百公里油耗。
def_en: Fuel mass per unit shaft work, commonly g/kWh; operating-point dependent, not vehicle fuel use per distance.

sources.title: ISO 2710-1:2026 — Engine design and operation vocabulary

name: 制动热效率
def: 轴端有效输出功率与燃料能量输入率之比；最大台架值不等于平均整车效率。
def_en: Shaft output divided by fuel-energy input rate; peak bench efficiency is not average vehicle efficiency.

sources.title: ISO 2710-1:2026 — Engine design and operation vocabulary
BYD — New DM-i technology and Xiaoyun engine (issuer press-release PDF mirror)

name: 指示热效率
def: 根据缸内压力做功计算的功率与燃料能量输入率之比；尚未扣除到轴端的全部机械损失，不能与BTE直接混用。
def_en: Cylinder-indicated power divided by fuel-energy input rate, before all mechanical losses to the output shaft.

sources.title: ISO 2710-1:2026 — Engine design and operation vocabulary

name: 十六烷值
def: 表征柴油压燃着火性能的指标，较高值一般对应较短着火延迟；它与汽油抗爆用的辛烷值不是同一尺度，也不是热值。
def_en: A measure of diesel ignition quality; a higher value generally means shorter ignition delay. It is neither petrol octane rating nor heating value.

sources.title: US DOE AFDC — Diesel vehicles using biodiesel

name: 挤流
def_en: Gas motion produced as the piston approaches top dead centre and displaces gas out of narrow clearance regions.

sources.title: General Motors — Combustion chamber, US2791996A

def: 活塞接近上止点时，将狭窄间隙内的气体挤向燃烧室其余区域所形成的气流；与进气道产生的滚流、涡流不是同一来源。

name: 进气道喷射
def_en: Fuel is injected upstream of the intake valve and enters the cylinder with the intake charge; injection location is separate from electronic control.

sources.title: Bosch — Gasoline port fuel injection

def: 喷油器在进气门前的进气道供油，混合气经进气门进入气缸；喷射位置与是否电子控制是两个不同分类维度。

name: 汽油颗粒过滤器
def_en: An exhaust filter that traps gasoline-engine particles and removes deposits through oxidation; it may carry catalytic coating.

sources.title: BASF — Four-way conversion catalyst for gasoline engines

def: 在汽油机排气中截留颗粒，并通过再生氧化清除积炭的过滤装置；可带催化涂层，与三元催化器处理气态污染物的功能有区别。

name: 机油冷却器
def_en: A heat exchanger transfers oil heat to air or coolant; an oil–coolant unit can also help warm the oil after a cold start.

sources.title: MAHLE — Engine cooling for passenger cars
Schaeffler Symposium 2014 — Hot & Cold

def: 通过换热器把机油热量传给空气或冷却液；油水换热器也可在冷启动时利用较快升温的冷却液帮助机油暖机。

name: 分体冷却
def_en: Separate regulation of cylinder-block and cylinder-head coolant circuits to meet different warm-up and thermal-load needs.

sources.title: Schaeffler Symposium 2014 — Hot & Cold

def: 分开调节缸体和缸盖的冷却液回路，让不同部位按热负荷与暖机需求获得不同温度控制。

name: 电动水泵
def_en: An electrically driven coolant pump whose flow can be controlled for thermal demand rather than being fixed to crankshaft speed.

sources.title: MAHLE — Engine cooling for passenger cars

def: 由电机驱动冷却液循环，可按热管理需求控制流量，不必让泵速始终随发动机曲轴转速变化。

name: ATAC热气氛燃烧
def_en: A two-stroke autoignition approach studied in a 1979 paper, using a hot in-cylinder atmosphere; an early related research milestone rather than all modern four-stroke HCCI.

sources.title: SAE — Active Thermo-Atmosphere Combustion (ATAC), 790501

def: 1979年论文研究的二冲程自燃方式，通过缸内热气氛帮助混合气着火；是均质压燃相关研究的早期节点，不等于现代四冲程HCCI的全部实现。
